AI Agent Stack Builder 1.0.0 – Initial release.

- Launches an intelligent system to recommend optimal AI agent technology stacks based on detailed project requirements and constraints.
- Provides tailored suggestions for frameworks, LLMs, and supporting technologies, including reasoning and prioritization.
- Implements endpoints to generate stack recommendations, review supported frameworks and LLMs, and check service health.
- Supports cost estimation, compliance notes, and implementation timeline prediction in recommendations.
- Includes comprehensive example requests/responses and clear API documentation.
